name: ATM Inquiry Request V 03
definition: The ATMInquiryRequest message is sent by an ATM to an ATM manager to request information about a customer (for example card, account).

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

ATMInquiryRequest.name: ATM Inquiry Request
ATMInquiryRequest.definition: Information related to the request of an inquiry from an ATM.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC.
